body:
Founder real-time: 'ensure that the client actually uses that model (download it when the game starts...) show on the screen what model is loaded' -> 'make sure the model downloads with lz4' -> 'make sure that the models have like some id number... datestamp to the second with the archetype type' -> 'can we train on the level called THREE from the registry?'. Shipped: scripts/export_policy_weights.py exports a real trained SB3 PPO actor network to a small binary format ('BPMW'); packages/common/mlp_policy.h is a real, generic C MLP loader+forward-pass, cross-language-parity-verified live (C output matches stable_baselines3's own predict() exactly on a real checkpoint); packages/common/ai_opponent.h wires this into the real client -- fetches the active checkpoint + LZ4-compressed weights at game start, drives the opponent's real input via the loaded policy (drop-in replacing bot_think), shows 'AI: DEFAULT' or 'AI: <name> (id=N) Elo <elo>' on screen always. IDUNA: Checkpoint.Name ('<role>_<YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>'), SetWeights/ReadWeights, GET .../weights (LZ4 default). apps/server/src/main.c: new --level <name> flag resolves a real level by name from the public registry and loads it via stage_set_active_from_leveldata, preserved across every PACKET_RESET_MATCH via STAGE_CUSTOM_MEMORY. Both features live-verified with real Xvfb+XTest screenshots of the actual compiled client: one showing the real 'AI: DEFAULT' HUD line in a live match, one showing a visibly different multi-platform stage after connecting to a server booted with --level THREE (id=6, a real founder-created level). 9 new Go tests + several new C/Python tests all pass. BRAWLPIT commits b0941a3/a2be366, IDUNA commits 481f36c/b9eefd5. Real, honest, named gaps: commander-posture edge-distance calc still hardcodes STAGE_FD's blast bounds for non-FD levels (degrades accuracy, doesn't break); Elo still never moves off 1500 for any checkpoint since nothing yet runs a real evaluation match (see S421-04, not built).

⚓ ☃
title: S421-02/S421-03: native client uses selected AI opponent (real MLP inference, LZ4 download, on-screen HUD) + train on a named registry level
